synthesis: On the admin Hits page in ClickHouse mode (admin impersonator / `clickhouse:hits`), clicking a cluster's 'Show Cluster on Map' button 500s the Livewire request (`/app/hits`) and nothing appears. Root cause: in ClickHouse mode the Hits table query is built from `App\Clickhouse\Models\Hit`, so `Table::getModel()` (and thus `$action->getModel()`) returns the CH Hit class; `sidebar-filters.blade.php` mounts `TableMapComponent` with that model plus `relationship = 'scans'` (from `BulkMapAction->setRelationship('scans')`). On click, `TableMapComponent::formatRecords()` runs `App\Clickhouse\Models\Hit::query()->whereIn('id',...)->get()->map(fn($r) => $r->scans)`, but the CH Hit model has no `scans` relationship -> RelationNotFoundException -> HTTP 500. Postgres mode works (the Postgres Hit has the relationship); the Scans page works (relationship=null, no hop).
root_cause: TableMapComponent::formatRecords() unconditionally resolves `$this->relationship` ('scans') on every record via `$record->{$this->relationship}`. In ClickHouse mode the record is an App\Clickhouse\Models\Hit, which has no `scans` relationship. CORRECTED MECHANISM (verified in tinker, not the earlier exception theory): Eloquent's magic accessor returns NULL for an undefined relationship (getRelationValue -> isRelation('scans')===false -> null), it does NOT throw. So formatRecords maps every CH hit to null, ->filter() drops them all, and returns [] -> hasData stays false -> the `filament-maps-widget/updateMapData` event is never dispatched -> the map never opens ('nothing appears'). Confirmed: Table::getModel()=getQuery()->getModel()::class (vendor/filament/tables HasRecords.php:113-124); ListHits::buildClickhouseQuery uses ClickhouseHit; `(new App\Clickhouse\Models\Hit)->scans` === null, isRelation('scans')===false. The console `/app/hits` 500s appear to be the SEPARATE init-time cascade (/geocode/reverse 502 + /nearest-given-address 500, fired per-cluster on init, scoped out by Dalton), NOT the map action — to be confirmed by live QA against real CH.

scope.summary: Make the Hits cluster-map 'Show Cluster on Map' button work in ClickHouse mode by not resolving a non-existent `scans` relationship, mapping the map pins from the denormalized CH hit record instead; keep Postgres + Scans behavior unchanged.

proposed_changes.change: In formatRecords(), only hop `$this->relationship` when the record actually defines that relationship (e.g. method_exists/isRelation guard); otherwise map from the record itself. Prevents the RelationNotFoundException on the CH Hit model.

Add read-only accessors so a CH Hit maps to the same map-pin shape the Postgres path produces: `ocr` (raw col exists), `us_state` (from scan_us_state), `vehicleImage` (scan_img from scan_guid, Plate type), `vehicle` (year/make/model), `address` (raw col exists). So pins show label/image/vehicle, matching Postgres.
proposed_changes.reason: without these the CH pins would render with a partial label and no image/vehicle

out_of_scope: The `/geocode/reverse` (502) and `/nearest-given-address` (500) init-time errors — separate HTTP endpoints fired per-cluster on init, independent of the button; recommend a separate ticket unless Dalton wants them folded in

acceptance_criteria.item: On the Hits page as an admin impersonator (ClickHouse hits) with Location Cluster enabled and a plate searched, clicking 'Show Cluster on Map' opens the Map section with the cluster's pins and no 500 / console error from the map action.
Map pins show the plate label and (where available) the vehicle image/details, matching the Postgres map behavior.
acceptance_criteria.reason: the CH hit is denormalized; pins should not regress vs Postgres

acceptance_criteria.item: Scans cluster map and the Postgres hits path remain working (no regression).

questions.q: What does the browser console error say when clicking 'Show Cluster on Map'?
questions.answer: AxiosError: Request failed with status code 500 on the /app/hits Livewire request (plus separate per-cluster init 500/502s on /geocode/reverse and /nearest-given-address). The 500 = the map action throwing server-side.

questions.q: Reproducing as admin impersonator / clickhouse:hits (CH path) or a normal client user (Postgres path)?
questions.answer: Admin impersonator AND clickhouse:hits enabled — i.e. the ClickHouse-backed hits path.

questions.q: Does the Map section appear at all (blank) on click, or does nothing happen?
questions.answer: Nothing happens/appears (consistent with the Livewire request 500ing before it can dispatch map data).

notes: Event chain: hits/cluster-group.blade.php:187 button $dispatch('load-records-for-map', {recordIds, center}) -> Livewire TableMapComponent#[On] loadRecordsForMap() -> formatRecords() -> (on success) dispatch filament-maps-widget/updateMapData -> JS widget. The 500 is inside formatRecords().

Why CH-only: Table::getModel() returns getQuery()->getModel()::class; buildClickhouseQuery() (ListHits.php:95-137) sets the table query's model to App\Clickhouse\Models\Hit, so $action->getModel() (sidebar-filters.blade.php:19-22) passes the CH model to TableMapComponent. Postgres mode passes App\Models\Hit which HAS scans().
hits_cold holds full history (hits_hot is the 90d-TTL hot copy), so formatRecords' default `new ClickhouseHit` (hits_cold) resolves ids for recent AND old hits — no hot/cold gap to fix.

A raw App\Clickhouse\Models\Hit::query()->find(id) exposes latitude/longitude accessors + raw columns ocr, scan_us_state, scan_guid, lat, lng, address, vehicle_year/make/model. It does NOT expose us_state/vehicleImage/vehicle accessors, so the CH accessors in the plan are needed for full pin parity.

REFUTED earlier hypotheses (kept for the record): invalid-JS center (Hit has lat/lng accessors), quoted-string ids breaking x-on:click (CH id is Int64), id mismatch (CH id==PG id), global-scope join error (only_basic filters hit_type only).
Precedent DEV-1684 (Done) fixed 'map cluster markers not rendering' on this surface; different mechanism (rendering) from this CH-relationship 500.
